resources.string: Add applications to create routing rules.
The system application picker is unavailable.
When disabled, only applications you select with a VPN rule use VPN. In the Whole device scenario this setting is always on and cannot be changed.

The Whole device scenario routes all traffic through VPN and ignores application rules.

The Proxy scenario applies VPN / Direct rules.

With Whole device enabled, all traffic uses VPN except applications marked Direct. With it disabled, only applications with a VPN rule use VPN.

The Direct rule uses the device’s normal connection and its system DNS settings, including Private DNS.

When enabled, traffic is temporarily blocked before active routing changes. The rules are then applied and VPN reconnects if needed. If the change could not be completed safely, stop VPN before trying again. When disabled, changing the scenario or the Whole device setting requires confirmation even if Ask for confirmation is off. Application rules apply automatically. A stopped VPN is not started.
When enabled, changing the scenario or toggling Whole device requires confirmation. Disabled by default.
Apply this routing change? A running VPN will reconnect if needed.

Open Scenarios using the button in the top row of the home screen. Choose routing for the whole device or individual applications.

Tap Add application and choose applications from the list, then assign VPN or Direct. Checked applications appear first. Use the application filter to show all, system, or user applications; user applications are shown by default. Press and hold a rule to remove it after confirmation. Your application list is retained when switching scenarios.

The Whole device scenario routes all traffic through VPN and ignores application rules.

The Proxy scenario uses rules for applications in the list. With Whole device enabled, all applications use VPN except those marked Direct. With it disabled, only applications with a VPN rule use VPN.

Scenario settings control atomic application and confirmation of changes. Atomic application is enabled by default: traffic is blocked before active routing changes, then the new rules are applied and VPN reconnects if needed. Confirmation is disabled by default. A stopped VPN does not start automatically.
